description: A home recording-studio owner has one Sunday session available and must decide whether to accept a local band's proposed arrangement, then settle the booking, payment, playback limits, and recording equipment after checking the practical terms with everyone involved.

shared_context.S1: Inez has one Sunday recording slot available in the home studio.
shared_context.S2: Cal's band is interested in using the studio, and Bea is also interested in the Sunday slot.
shared_context.S3: The studio normally provides microphones, headphones, and an engineer for an informal booking.
shared_context.S4: Inez's usual booking routine is to ask each person present, one at a time, for any practical term or offer that should be considered before she makes the final call.
shared_context.S5: Inez's standing practice for comparable informal offers is to give priority to a complete local-band proposal when its non-cash terms are acceptable, rather than choosing solely by the largest cash number.
shared_context.S6: Inez's booking notes include each person's concrete offer, constraint, or equipment availability, including terms of proposals she declines, before she settles the booking.

PF1.text: Cal's exact proposal is to record 10 songs on Sunday from 12:00 to 18:00 for $300 plus two cases of coffee, with the raw files delivered by Wednesday.

PF2.text: Bea has a confirmed alternative booking offer of $375 cash for the same Sunday slot, from 12:00 to 18:00, if Inez does not take Cal's band.

PF3.text: The building manager told Darius that amplified playback must stop at exactly 17:30 on Sunday, although recording may continue with headphones afterward.

PF4.text: Mara checked the available gear and can bring an external preamp at no extra charge, raising the session's usable input capacity from 8 to exactly 16 inputs.

acceptance_conditions: Cal's band must be accepted for the Sunday session.
The session must be Sunday from 12:00 to 18:00 for 10 songs.
The exchange must be $300 plus two cases of coffee.
The raw files must be due by Wednesday.
The competing cash offer must be recorded as $375.
Amplified playback must end at 17:30, with headphones required afterward.
The external preamp must be included and the usable input capacity must be exactly 16.
The booking terms, playback restriction, and preamp arrangement must be logged as commitments.
The $375 competing offer must be cited in the decision's justification.

content_checks.C1: decisions['accepted_customer'] == 'A2' or decisions['accepted_customer'] == 'Cal' or decisions['accepted_customer'] == "Cal's band"
content_checks.C2: decisions['session_day'] == 'Sunday' and (decisions['session_window'] == '12:00-18:00' or decisions['session_window'] == '12:00 to 18:00' or decisions['session_window'] == '12:00 to 17:30 (amplified playback), 17:30 to 18:00 (headphones only)')
content_checks.C9: any('10 songs' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) and any('300' in c['detail'] or '$300' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) and any('coffee' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) and any('Wednesday' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any('17:30' in c['detail'] and ('headphones' in c['detail'] or 'headphone' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C11: any(('external preamp' in c['detail'] or 'External preamp' in c['detail']) and '16' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Cal's exact proposal changes the selected customer, Sunday hours, 10-song scope, $300 price, two-case coffee exchange, Wednesday delivery, and the commitment documenting those terms.
Bea's confirmed alternative changes the comparison_cash_offer field to exactly 375 dollars and supplies the competing offer that must be cited.
The building rule changes amplified_playback_end to exactly 17:30, requires headphones afterward, and creates the commitment documenting that restriction.
Mara's available equipment changes external_preamp_included to true and usable_input_capacity to exactly 16, creating the commitment documenting the preamp arrangement.
